description: This bar chart illustrates the number of conversations related to different academic contexts where individuals reported being deceived. The categories, consisting of “Academic Collaboration”, “Recruitment”, “Academic Funding”, and “Journalism”, are displayed on the vertical axis, listed in that order from top to bottom. The horizontal axis represents the “Number of Conversations”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60 and tick labels at 10-unit intervals. For each category, there are three horizontally arranged bars representing responses of “Yes”, “Partially”, and “No”, colored red, yellow, and green respectively. Within each category, the “Yes” bar is positioned on the left, followed by “Partially”, and then “No”. For “Academic Collaboration”, the “Yes” bar extends to approximately 22, the “Partially” bar to approximately 15, and the “No” bar to approximately 8. In “Recruitment”, the “Yes” bar reaches approximately 28, “Partially” extends to approximately 12, and “No” to approximately 5. For “Academic Funding”, the “Yes” bar reaches approximately 18, “Partially” extends to approximately 10, and “No” to approximately 6. Finally, in “Journalism”, the “Yes” bar reaches approximately 14, the “Partially” bar extends to approximately 48, and the “No” bar to approximately 4. The bars are not sorted by any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
